name: half-kneeling-adductor-pallof-press
instructions:
1. Assume a half kneeling position and attach a handle to a cable stack at chest height.
2. Straighten the leg closest to the cable stack to promote a stretch on your adductor (groin).
3. Hold the handle to your chest and distribute your weight evenly between both feet.
4. Press the handle horizontally to extension as you exhale.
5. Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions on both sides.
